question_vi: Spring Boot 3 chuẩn hoá response lỗi bằng gì? `ProblemDetail` dùng ra sao?
question_en: How does Spring Boot 3 standardize error responses? How is `ProblemDetail` used?
answer_html_vi:
Bằng ProblemDetail — cài đặt của RFC 9457 (bản kế thừa RFC 7807), trả Content-Type: application/problem+json với các field chuẩn type, title, status, detail, instance cộng field mở rộng tuỳ ý.

Hai cách dùng:

java
// 1. trả ProblemDetail từ handler
@RestControllerAdvice
public class ApiExceptionHandler {

    @ExceptionHandler(OrderNotFoundException.class)
    ProblemDetail handleNotFound(OrderNotFoundException ex) {
        ProblemDetail pd = ProblemDetail.forStatusAndDetail(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, ex.getMessage());
        pd.setTitle("Order not found");
        pd.setProperty("orderId", ex.getOrderId());
        return pd;
    }
}
properties
# 2. let Spring render built-in MVC exceptions as problem details
spring.mvc.problemdetails.enabled=true

Kế thừa ResponseEntityExceptionHandler trong @ControllerAdvice để nhận sẵn handler cho toàn bộ exception chuẩn của Spring MVC (MethodArgumentNotValidException, HttpMessageNotReadableException...) và chỉ override cái nào cần đổi nội dung.

Lợi ích thực tế: client và các service khác parse một shape lỗi duy nhất, thay vì mỗi team tự chế {code, message, errors} riêng.
answer_html_en:
Through ProblemDetail — an implementation of RFC 9457 (successor to RFC 7807), returning Content-Type: application/problem+json with the standard fields type, title, status, detail, instance plus arbitrary extensions.

Two ways to use it:

java
// 1. return ProblemDetail from a handler
@RestControllerAdvice
public class ApiExceptionHandler {

    @ExceptionHandler(OrderNotFoundException.class)
    ProblemDetail handleNotFound(OrderNotFoundException ex) {
        ProblemDetail pd = ProblemDetail.forStatusAndDetail(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, ex.getMessage());
        pd.setTitle("Order not found");
        pd.setProperty("orderId", ex.getOrderId());
        return pd;
    }
}
properties
# 2. let Spring render built-in MVC exceptions as problem details
spring.mvc.problemdetails.enabled=true

Extend ResponseEntityExceptionHandler in a @ControllerAdvice to inherit handlers for all standard Spring MVC exceptions (MethodArgumentNotValidException, HttpMessageNotReadableException, …) and override only what you need to reshape.

The practical value: clients and downstream services parse one error shape instead of each team inventing its own {code, message, errors}.
